Fades a sprite out where it gets close to something solid behind it, which is what makes smoke, fire and fog made of sprites (soft particles) blend into the scene instead of cutting a hard line where they poke into a wall or the ground. The sprite is faded by the distance in front of the solid surface: at that distance or more it is as it would be without the command, and where it touches the surface it is gone. The distance is in world units (the same as `PositionEntity`), so a sprite 10 units across with a distance of 2 fades over the last 2 units next to the surface.

A distance close to 0 (or less) turns the effect off, which is the default, and sprites without it cost nothing extra. The effect needs the sprite to be see-through: it works with `EntityAlpha` and the alpha of the texture (`EntityBlend 1`), and with `EntityBlend 3` (add). It does nothing for sprites that are solid or masked, and with `EntityBlend 2` (multiply), which does not look at alpha. Only what was drawn before the sprites is taken into account: solid meshes, terrain and planes, not other sprites. It works for perspective and orthographic cameras.

```blitzbasic
;media still sprites/setspritesoftedge.png
Graphics3D 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
camera = CreateCamera()
CameraClsColor camera, 40, 60, 90
PositionEntity camera, 0, 3, -5
RotateEntity camera, 20, 0, 0
light = CreateLight()
RotateEntity light, 45, 30, 0
floor = CreatePlane()
EntityColor floor, 90, 120, 80

; Two big smoke sprites standing in the ground: the left one with a hard edge, the right one with a soft edge.
For side = 0 To 1
	tex = CreateTexture(64, 64, 3)
	SetBuffer TextureBuffer(tex)
	ClsColor 230, 230, 230
	Cls
	SetBuffer BackBuffer()
	sprite = CreateSprite()
	EntityTexture sprite, tex
	EntityAlpha sprite, 0.8
	ScaleSprite sprite, 2.2, 2.2
	PositionEntity sprite, -2.6 + side * 5.2, 0.3, 2
	If side = 1 Then SetSpriteSoftEdge sprite, 2
Next
RenderWorld
Flip
WaitKey
```
@param sprite                The sprite.
@param soft_edge_distance    How far in front of a solid surface (world units) the sprite is faded out. 0 or less turns the effect off.
@gap The original has no such command. This is an extension; programs that use it do not compile with the original Blitz3D.
